[Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)

You may use, share and adapt them for any purpose, including commercially, as long as
you give credit. Suggested credit:

> Synthetic human from [b2crunner](https://github.com/Erant/b2crunner), CC BY 4.0

**These are synthetic people.** Every figure was generated by the b2crunner pipeline from
a generated reference sheet; none depicts a real individual. When you reuse one, please
keep it clear that it is synthetic.

## Fan art: not covered

A few subjects are fan art of existing characters that we do not own (for example Vi from
Arcane, owned by Riot Games, and Princess Zelda from The Legend of Zelda, owned by Nintendo).
These are **not** licensed under CC BY 4.0 or any other license from us: the characters belong
to their owners. They are marked as fan art on the page, which offers no download for them, and
their entries in `data/runs/` carry a `fan_art` field naming the character and its owner. The
files that make them up (`splats/`, `clips/`, `thumbs/`, `inputs/` and `data/runs/` for those ids)
are excluded from the license above.
